amc8-1988-q1.summary: A measuring scale runs from $10$ to $11$ with quarter-unit ticks. Its pointer is slightly past the $10.25$ tick. Estimate the reading. Options: A $10.05$, B $10.15$, C $10.25$, D $10.3$, E $10.6$.
amc8-1988-q1.summaryZh: 一只测量仪表的刻度从 $10$ 到 $11$，每隔四分之一个单位有一条刻线；指针略微越过 $10.25$ 刻线。估计读数。选项为 A $10.05$，B $10.15$，C $10.25$，D $10.3$，E $10.6$。

methods.title: Interpolate between adjacent ticks
steps: The marked ticks represent $10,10.25,10.50,10.75,11$.
The pointer is just beyond $10.25$ but well before $10.50$, so $10.3$ is the only reasonable estimate.
stepsZh: 指针略过 $10.25$，但明显未到 $10.50$，所以唯一合理的估读是 $10.3$。

amc8-1988-q2.summary: Evaluate $8\times0.25\times2\times0.125$. Options: A $1/8$, B $1/4$, C $1/2$, D $1$, E $2$.

methods.title: Pair reciprocal factors
steps: Reorder the product: $(8\cdot\frac18)(2\cdot\frac14)=1\cdot\frac12=\frac12$.

methods.title: Reduce before adding
steps: Each term equals one tenth: $2/20=3/30=1/10$.
Thus the sum is $3/10=0.3$.

amc8-1988-q4.summary: A triangular checkerboard has $8$ horizontal rows. In every row the unit squares alternate dark and light, beginning and ending with a dark square. By how many does the number of dark squares exceed the number of light squares?
amc8-1988-q4.summaryZh: 一个三角形棋盘有 $8$ 条水平行。每行的单位方格按深、浅色交替排列，并且首尾都是深色方格。深色方格比浅色方格多多少个？

methods.title: Count the surplus row by row
steps: In one alternating row that starts and ends dark, pair every light square with the dark square immediately before it.
Exactly one dark square remains unpaired in each row. Eight rows therefore contribute a total surplus of $8$.
stepsZh: 在任意一条首尾均为深色的交替行中，把每个浅色方格与它前面的深色方格配对。
每行恰剩一个未配对的深色方格，因此八行的总差值为 $8$。

amc8-1988-q5.summary: A protractor has centre $B$, with its left baseline labelled $0^\circ$ and right baseline $180^\circ$. Ray $BA$ passes through $20^\circ$, ray $BD$ through $160^\circ$, and $\angle CBD=90^\circ$. Estimate $\angle ABC$. Options: A $20^\circ$, B $40^\circ$, C $50^\circ$, D $70^\circ$, E $120^\circ$.
amc8-1988-q5.summaryZh: 量角器中心为 $B$，左端基线标作 $0^\circ$、右端标作 $180^\circ$。射线 $BA$ 通过 $20^\circ$ 刻度，射线 $BD$ 通过 $160^\circ$ 刻度，且 $\angle CBD=90^\circ$。估计 $\angle ABC$。选项为 A $20^\circ$，B $40^\circ$，C $50^\circ$，D $70^\circ$，E $120^\circ$。

methods.title: Subtract protractor readings
steps: Since $BD$ is at $160^\circ$ and $\angle CBD=90^\circ$, ray $BC$ is at $160^\circ-90^\circ=70^\circ$ on the same scale.
Therefore $\angle ABC=70^\circ-20^\circ=50^\circ$.
stepsZh: $BD$ 位于 $160^\circ$ 刻度，而 $\angle CBD=90^\circ$，故同一刻度上的 $BC$ 读数为 $160^\circ-90^\circ=70^\circ$。

methods.title: Pair equal powers
steps: Since $0.2/0.02=10$, the value is $0.2\cdot100=20$.

amc8-1988-q7.summary: Which hundred is closest to $2.46\times8.163\times(5.17+4.829)$? Options: A $100$, B $200$, C $300$, D $400$, E $500$.

methods.title: Round compatible factors
methods.titleZh: 把因子估成便于相乘的数
steps: The parenthesis is $5.17+4.829=9.999$, essentially $10$.
Also $2.46\approx2.5$ and $8.163\approx8$, so the product is about $2.5\cdot8\cdot10=200$.

amc8-1988-q8.summary: Betty intended to multiply $0.075\times2.56$ but entered the digits without decimal points; the calculator displayed $19200$. What should the correct product be? Options: A $0.0192$, B $0.192$, C $1.92$, D $19.2$, E $192$.
amc8-1988-q8.summaryZh: Betty 原想计算 $0.075\times2.56$，但输入时漏掉小数点，计算器显示 $19200$。正确乘积是多少？选项为 A $0.0192$，B $0.192$，C $1.92$，D $19.2$，E $192$。

methods.title: Restore the decimal places
steps: The two factors contain $3+2=5$ decimal places in total.
Place the decimal five digits from the right in $19200$: $0.19200=0.192$.
stepsZh: 两个因数的小数位数合计为 $3+2=5$ 位。

methods.title: Compare squared side lengths
steps: For lattice points, compare $\Delta x^2+\Delta y^2$ instead of taking square roots.
The five squared-side triples are $(5,5,4)$, $(4,4,8)$, $(10,10,36)$, $(5,4,13)$, and $(5,5,10)$, respectively.
The first, second, third, and fifth triples contain an equal pair; the fourth does not. Hence exactly four triangles are isosceles.
stepsZh: 对格点之间的距离，无需开方，只比较 $\Delta x^2+\Delta y^2$。
第一、二、三、五组均有两个相等值，第四组没有，所以恰有四个等腰三角形。

amc8-1988-q10.summary: Chris's birthday is on a Thursday. What weekday is $60$ days later? Options: A Monday, B Wednesday, C Thursday, D Friday, E Saturday.
amc8-1988-q10.summaryZh: Chris 的生日是星期四。$60$ 天后是星期几？选项为 A 星期一，B 星期三，C 星期四，D 星期五，E 星期六。

methods.title: Reduce modulo seven
steps: Since $60=8\cdot7+4$, only four extra days affect the weekday.
Four days after Thursday are Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday.
stepsZh: 因为 $60=8\cdot7+4$，整周不改变星期，只需向后数四天。
星期四之后依次为星期五、星期六、星期日、星期一。

amc8-1988-q11.summary: Locate $\sqrt{164}$. Options: A $42$, B less than $10$, C between $10$ and $11$, D between $11$ and $12$, E between $12$ and $13$.
amc8-1988-q11.summaryZh: 判断 $\sqrt{164}$ 所在范围。选项为 A $42$，B 小于 $10$，C 在 $10$ 与 $11$ 之间，D 在 $11$ 与 $12$ 之间，E 在 $12$ 与 $13$ 之间。

methods.title: Bracket by consecutive squares
methods.titleZh: 用相邻完全平方数夹逼
steps: The consecutive squares around $164$ are $12^2=144$ and $13^2=169$.

amc8-1988-q12.summary: An estimated $20$ billion dollar Mars mission cost is shared equally by $250$ million people. Find each person's share. Options: A $40$, B $50$, C $80$, D $100$, E $125$.
amc8-1988-q12.summaryZh: 一项火星任务估计耗资 $200$ 亿美元，由 $2.5$ 亿人平均分担。每人应分担多少？选项为 A $40$ 美元，B $50$ 美元，C $80$ 美元，D $100$ 美元，E $125$ 美元。

methods.title: Use the same large-number unit
steps: Write $20$ billion as $20{,}000$ million.
Then $20{,}000\text{ million}/250\text{ million}=20{,}000/250=80$ dollars per person.

amc8-1988-q13.summary: Rose bushes are planted about one foot apart around a circular patio of radius $12$ feet. Approximately how many bushes are needed? Options: A $12$, B $38$, C $48$, D $75$, E $450$.
amc8-1988-q13.summaryZh: 沿半径为 $12$ 英尺的圆形露台边缘种玫瑰，相邻花丛约相隔 $1$ 英尺。大约需要多少丛？选项为 A $12$，B $38$，C $48$，D $75$，E $450$。

methods.title: Use the circumference
steps: The boundary length is $2\pi r=24\pi\approx75.4$ feet.
At roughly one bush per foot, about $75$ bushes are required.
stepsZh: 露台边缘长度为 $2\pi r=24\pi\approx75.4$ 英尺。
按每英尺约一丛，需要约 $75$ 丛。

amc8-1988-q14.summary: Whole numbers $x,y$ satisfy $xy=36$. Find the largest possible value of $x+y$. Options: A $12$, B $13$, C $15$, D $20$, E $37$.
amc8-1988-q14.summaryZh: 非负整数 $x,y$ 满足 $xy=36$。求 $x+y$ 的最大可能值。选项为 A $12$，B $13$，C $15$，D $20$，E $37$。

methods.title: List positive factor pairs
steps: Because the product is positive and equals $36$, the relevant whole-number pairs are $(1,36),(2,18),(3,12),(4,9),(6,6)$.
Their sums are $37,20,15,13,12$; the largest is $37$.

amc8-1988-q15.summary: Find the reciprocal of $\frac12+\frac13$. Options: A $1/6$, B $2/5$, C $6/5$, D $5/2$, E $5$.

methods.title: Add first, then invert
steps: Combine the fractions: $\frac12+\frac13=\frac36+\frac26=\frac56$.
The reciprocal of $5/6$ is $6/5$.

amc8-1988-q16.summary: Place at most one $X$ in each cell of a $3\times3$ grid. What is the greatest number of $X$'s possible if no row, column, or main diagonal may contain three $X$'s? Options: A $2$, B $3$, C $4$, D $5$, E $6$.
amc8-1988-q16.summaryZh: 在一个 $3\times3$ 方格中，每格至多放一个 $X$。若任何一行、一列或两条主对角线都不能出现三个 $X$，最多能放多少个 $X$？选项为 A $2$，B $3$，C $4$，D $5$，E $6$。

methods.title: Upper bound and construction
steps: If $7$ X's were placed in three rows, some row would contain at least $\lceil7/3\rceil=3$ X's, which is forbidden. Thus at most $6$ X's are possible.
The bound is attainable: leave the centre and two opposite corners empty. These three cells meet all three rows, all three columns, and both main diagonals, so the other six cells may contain X's.
stepsZh: 若在三行中放入 $7$ 个 $X$，由抽屉原理，至少一行含 $\lceil7/3\rceil=3$ 个 $X$，与条件矛盾。因此最多只能放 $6$ 个。
该上界可达到：留中心格和一对相对角格为空。这三格覆盖三行、三列及两条主对角线，其余六格均可放 $X$。

amc8-1988-q17.summary: A horizontal $10\times2$ rectangle and a perpendicular vertical $3\times8$ rectangle overlap in a $3\times2$ rectangle. Find the area of their union. Options: A $23$, B $38$, C $44$, D $46$, E cannot be determined.
amc8-1988-q17.summaryZh: 一个 $10\times2$ 的水平长方形与一个 $3\times8$ 的竖直长方形垂直相交，重叠部分为 $3\times2$ 长方形。求两图形并集面积。选项为 A $23$，B $38$，C $44$，D $46$，E 无法确定。

methods.title: Inclusion–exclusion for area
steps: The two rectangle areas are $10\cdot2=20$ and $3\cdot8=24$.
Their $3\times2$ overlap has area $6$ and was counted twice, so the union area is $20+24-6=38$.
stepsZh: 两个长方形面积分别为 $10\cdot2=20$ 与 $3\cdot8=24$。
$3\times2$ 的重叠区域面积为 $6$，相加时被重复计算，故并集面积为 $20+24-6=38$。

methods.title: Decompose into disjoint pieces
methods.titleZh: 分割成互不重叠的部分
steps: Keep the whole horizontal rectangle, area $20$.
The parts of the vertical rectangle outside it have total height $8-2=6$ and width $3$, hence area $18$. Thus the total is $20+18=38$.
stepsZh: 保留整个水平长方形，面积为 $20$。
竖直长方形伸出部分总高为 $8-2=6$、宽为 $3$，面积为 $18$，所以总面积为 $20+18=38$。

amc8-1988-q18.summary: Six boys have average weight $150$ pounds and four girls have average weight $120$ pounds. Find the average weight of all ten children. Options: A $135$, B $137$, C $138$, D $140$, E $141$ pounds.
amc8-1988-q18.summaryZh: 六名男生的平均体重为 $150$ 磅，四名女生的平均体重为 $120$ 磅。求十名学生的平均体重。选项为 A $135$，B $137$，C $138$，D $140$，E $141$ 磅。

methods.title: Combine total weights
steps: The boys' total is $6\cdot150=900$ pounds and the girls' total is $4\cdot120=480$ pounds.
The combined average is $(900+480)/10=138$ pounds.
stepsZh: 男生总重量为 $6\cdot150=900$ 磅，女生总重量为 $4\cdot120=480$ 磅。

methods.title: Use the arithmetic-sequence formula
methods.titleZh: 使用等差数列通项公式
steps: The first term is $1$ and the common difference is $4$.

amc8-1988-q20.summary: A cylindrical coffee maker's gauge shows $45$ cups when it is $36\%$ full. How many cups does it hold when full? Options: A $80$, B $100$, C $125$, D $130$, E $262$.
amc8-1988-q20.summaryZh: 一个圆柱形咖啡壶的刻度显示：装有 $45$ 杯时达到容量的 $36\%$。装满时可容纳多少杯？选项为 A $80$，B $100$，C $125$，D $130$，E $262$。

methods.title: Divide the part by its percentage
methods.titleZh: 用部分量除以所占百分比
steps: Let the full capacity be $C$. Then $0.36C=45$.

amc8-1988-q21.summary: A number $n$ is added to $\{3,6,9,10\}$. For how many real values of $n$ does the mean of the five numbers equal their median? Options: A $1$, B $2$, C $3$, D $4$, E more than $4$.
amc8-1988-q21.summaryZh: 向集合 $\{3,6,9,10\}$ 中加入一个实数 $n$。有多少个 $n$ 使五个数的平均数等于中位数？选项为 A $1$，B $2$，C $3$，D $4$，E 多于 $4$。

methods.title: Split by the position of the new number
methods.titleZh: 按新数在排序中的位置分类
steps: The mean is $(28+n)/5$. If $n\le6$, the median is $6$, giving $n=2$, which fits this case.
If $6\le n\le9$, the median is $n$, giving $(28+n)/5=n$ and hence $n=7$.
If $n\ge9$, the median is $9$, giving $n=17$. All three candidates satisfy their assumed ranges, so there are three values.
stepsZh: 平均数为 $(28+n)/5$。若 $n\le6$，中位数为 $6$，解得 $n=2$，符合范围。
若 $n\ge9$，中位数为 $9$，解得 $n=17$。三个候选值都符合各自范围，所以共有三个。

amc8-1988-q22.summary: A shop raises every original price by $25\%$, then discounts the raised prices by $20\%$. Which statement describes the final sale price? A It is $5\%$ higher than the original; B it is higher by less than $5\%$; C it is higher by more than $5\%$; D it is lower; E it is the same as the original.
amc8-1988-q22.summaryZh: 一家商店先把所有原价提高 $25\%$，再按提高后的价格打八折。最终售价如何？A 比原价高 $5\%$；B 比原价高但不足 $5\%$；C 比原价高且超过 $5\%$；D 比原价低；E 与原价相同。
amc8-1988-q22.answer: E. The sale price is the same as the original price.

methods.title: Multiply successive percentage factors
methods.titleZh: 相乘连续百分比变化因子
steps: A $25\%$ increase multiplies by $1.25$; a $20\%$ discount multiplies by $0.80$.
The combined factor is $1.25\cdot0.80=1$, so the final price equals the original.
stepsZh: 合成因子为 $1.25\cdot0.80=1$，所以最终售价等于原价。

amc8-1988-q23.summary: Maria buys computer disks at $4$ for $5$ dollars and sells them at $3$ for $5$ dollars. How many disks must she sell to earn a profit of $100$ dollars? Options: A $100$, B $120$, C $200$, D $240$, E $1200$.
amc8-1988-q23.summaryZh: Maria 以每 $4$ 张 $5$ 美元的价格买入电脑磁盘，再以每 $3$ 张 $5$ 美元的价格卖出。要获利 $100$ 美元，她必须卖出多少张？选项为 A $100$，B $120$，C $200$，D $240$，E $1200$。

methods.title: Use profit per disk
steps: Each disk costs $5/4$ dollars and sells for $5/3$ dollars, so profit per disk is $5/3-5/4=5/12$ dollar.
The number required is $100/(5/12)=240$.
stepsZh: 每张成本为 $5/4$ 美元，售价为 $5/3$ 美元，故每张利润为 $5/3-5/4=5/12$ 美元。

methods.title: Work in batches of twelve
steps: Twelve disks cost $3\cdot5=15$ dollars and sell for $4\cdot5=20$ dollars, a profit of $5$ dollars.
A $100$-dollar profit needs $20$ such batches, or $20\cdot12=240$ disks.
stepsZh: 十二张磁盘的成本为 $3\cdot5=15$ 美元，售价为 $4\cdot5=20$ 美元，每批利润 $5$ 美元。

amc8-1988-q24.summary: A square containing an upward-pointing marked triangle begins with its bottom edge against the top edge of a fixed regular hexagon. It rolls clockwise around three consecutive vertices until it reaches the bottom edge of the hexagon. In which direction does the marked triangle point then?
amc8-1988-q24.summaryZh: 一个正方形内部标有一个初始向上的实心三角形；正方形的下边最初贴在固定正六边形的上边。它沿六边形外侧顺时针绕过连续三个顶点，直至到达六边形底边。此时标记三角形指向哪个方向？
amc8-1988-q24.answer: A. It points to the right.

methods.title: Track the rotation at each vertex
methods.titleZh: 追踪每个顶点处的转角
steps: At each hexagon vertex, the square turns through $360^\circ-120^\circ-90^\circ=150^\circ$ clockwise.
After three vertices the total is $3\cdot150^\circ=450^\circ$, equivalent to $90^\circ$ clockwise.
An upward-pointing triangle rotated $90^\circ$ clockwise points right.
stepsZh: 每经过六边形一个顶点，正方形顺时针转过 $360^\circ-120^\circ-90^\circ=150^\circ$。
经过三个顶点的总转角为 $3\cdot150^\circ=450^\circ$，等价于顺时针 $90^\circ$。
原先向上的三角形顺时针旋转 $90^\circ$ 后指向右方。

amc8-1988-q25.summary: Ignore the colon in a digital time and call the display palindromic if its digits read the same forwards and backwards; examples are $1{:}01$, $4{:}44$, and $12{:}21$. How many palindromic displays occur in a $12$-hour period? Options: A $57$, B $60$, C $63$, D $90$, E $93$.
amc8-1988-q25.summaryZh: 忽略电子钟时间中的冒号；若所得数字串正读、反读相同，就称该时刻为回文时刻，例如 $1{:}01$、$4{:}44$、$12{:}21$。一个 $12$ 小时周期内共有多少个回文时刻？选项为 A $57$，B $60$，C $63$，D $90$，E $93$。

methods.title: Separate one-digit and two-digit hours
methods.titleZh: 区分一位数与两位数小时
steps: For a one-digit hour $h=1,\ldots,9$, the display has form $h{:}th$, where the tens digit $t$ of the minutes may be any of $0,1,\ldots,5$. This gives $9\cdot6=54$ times.
For two-digit hours, only $10{:}01$, $11{:}11$, and $12{:}21$ work, giving $3$ more.
The total is $54+3=57$.
stepsZh: 对一位数小时 $h=1,\ldots,9$，回文显示必须形如 $h{:}th$，分钟十位 $t$ 可为 $0,1,\ldots,5$，共有 $9\cdot6=54$ 个。
